title: Cost tiers derived from a price catalog, no tier file
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. When a price catalog entry exists derive the tier from it; cost_tiers.json remains only an override. Tests zc_cost_from_catalog_*.
